health.attention_fact.definition:
select "health"."attention"."id" as "attentionId", "health"."attention"."timestamp" as "timestamp", "health"."speciality"."name" as "speciality", "auth"."organization"."name" as "alliedOrganization", "health"."attention"."user_id" as "patientId", "auth"."user"."sex" as "patientSex", FLOOR(DATE_PART('year', AGE(NOW(), "auth"."user"."birth_date"))) as "patientAge", "auth"."user"."document_type" as "patientDocumentType", "health"."patient_info"."insurance_type" as "patientInsuranceType", "health"."activity"."id" as "activityId", "health"."activity"."name" as "activityName", "health"."activity"."date" as "activityDate", "registrations", "rewarded", "newParticipants", "auth"."region"."name" as "activityRegion", "health"."activity_type"."name" as "activityType", "health"."activity_status"."name" as "activityStatus" from "health"."attention" inner join "health"."allied_participation" on "health"."attention"."allied_participation_id" = "health"."allied_participation"."id" inner join "health"."activity" on "health"."allied_participation"."activity_id" = "health"."activity"."id" inner join "auth"."organization" on "health"."allied_participation"."allied_id" = "auth"."organization"."id" inner join "health"."speciality" on "health"."allied_participation"."speciality_id" = "health"."speciality"."id" inner join "auth"."region" on "health"."activity"."region_id" = "auth"."region"."id" inner join "health"."activity_type" on "health"."activity"."type_id" = "health"."activity_type"."id" inner join "health"."activity_status" on "health"."activity"."status_id" = "health"."activity_status"."id" inner join "health"."patient_info" on "health"."attention"."user_id" = "health"."patient_info"."user_id" inner join "auth"."user" on "health"."attention"."user_id" = "auth"."user"."id" left join (select activity_user.activity_id as "activityId", count("health"."activity_user"."user_id") as "registrations", COUNT(CASE WHEN "health"."activity_user"."rewarded" = true THEN 1 END) as "rewarded", 
      COUNT(DISTINCT activity_user.user_id)
      FILTER (
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "health"."activity_user" au2
          WHERE au2.user_id = activity_user.user_id
          AND au2.timestamp < activity_user.timestamp
        )
      )
       as "newParticipants" from "health"."activity_user" inner join "health"."activity" on "health"."activity_user"."activity_id" = "health"."activity"."id" inner join "health"."activity_status" on "health"."activity"."status_id" = "health"."activity_status"."id" where "health"."activity_status"."name" <> 'Cancelado' group by "health"."activity_user"."activity_id") "activity_user_stats" on "health"."activity"."id" = "activityId" where "health"."activity_status"."name" <> 'Cancelado'
health.attention_fact.name: attention_fact
